purpose: Probe A, domain half (docs/plans/delegation-threads.md): the domain mints a sealed context over a thread area from its context arena and enters it with a nested, unsupervised CALL from its supervised main context; checks the seal layout, the entry, exit and re-entry paths, and the revoke/remint cycle before any monitor, driver or QEMU change

platform.note: the delegation-signals platform, unchanged: the same binaries the signal contract record 20260929-signal-contract.json ran on

qemu.source: capstone-qemu ac2837aa0e, tree identical to the pinned d6cca7f76b (65890ecbc2ce)

launcher.source: capstone-exec built from this branch; the launcher is unchanged by this step

platform.vm: one hart, 8 GiB, CMA 1024 MiB, process cache 384 MiB, CAPSTONE_GP_NONLIN=1, CAPSTONE_REV_NODES=65536

context_probe.runner: run-context.py with --host-image and --nm: a negative mode passes only on the expected cause at the expected symbol

modes.nested-enter: PASS: own sp inside the area's stack, own TLS block (the parent's __thread word unchanged), one global counter, capability-global initializer intact, constructors ran once
modes.nested-preempt: PASS: 40,000,000 LCG rounds in the child, result equal to the parent's own computation; the child ran 7088 ms, far beyond one 5 ms quantum
modes.nested-reenter: PASS: three further entries of the exited context each report EXITED; counter and return value unchanged
modes.remint: PASS: revoke the parent handle, mint into the same area, the new start function runs and returns 1007 on the new stack
modes.revoked-call: PASS: after the revoke the seal reloads untagged (ISSUES Q-11) and the CALL faults: cause=24 at __capstone_context_call_insn (image offset 0x10420)

method: capstone-vm, one boot per run; the regression rebuilt signal-contract.dom and application-contract.dom with this branch's runtime (start-musl.S, tls.c, context.c); perl.dom and mruby.dom are the delegation-signals images, not rebuilt, so the gate's real-application checks do not exercise this branch's runtime
notes: a child entered by a nested CALL must not make a delegated call: its yield returns to the nested caller, not to the launcher; the probe's start functions compute and store only

on this platform CALL (helper_cscall) checks the seal's tag and type, not its revocation node; a revoked seal is refused only because a capability loaded from memory after its node was revoked comes back untagged (Q-11)
